GameSave.title: GameSave
GameSave.description: Persistent cloud save document for a player in Legend of the Immortal East, storing metadata and signed serialized game state.

playerId.description: Unique identifier matching the document ID and owner UID.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

playerName.description: Sanitized Arabic/display name of the hero.

statePayload.description: Complete serialized RPG state JSON string.

signature.description: Tamper-detection FNV-1a dual signature of statePayload.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud save was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud save was last updated.

/game_saves/{playerId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's RPG save state indexed by their Firebase Auth UID.
